function compareText(value: never): boolean {
  return value > "a";
}

function shiftBig(value: never): bigint {
  return value >>> 1n;
}

function multiply(value: never, other: number | bigint) {
  return value * other;
}

function addSymbol(value: never, key: symbol) {
  return value + key;
}

function readMember(value: never) {
  return value.size;
}

function loop(value: never): void {
  for (const item of value) console.log(item);
}

function shiftAny(value: any): bigint {
  return value >>> 1n;
}

function accepted(value: never) {
  const { size } = value;
  return [value - 1n, value + "!", value[0], [...value], size, -value, value < value];
}
